quote:
Result Type
Successful Replication ... Those primed with cleanliness rated the behaviors less severely than did those in the control group, t(58)=-1.8, p<.04. This result is consistent with the results of the original study.
reason: Primary source identity is verified as Besman, Dubensky, Dunsmore, and Daubman (2013; PsychFileDrawer report #149, replicating Schnall et al., 2008, Experiment 1). The report conducts a single focal test of the cleanliness priming effect on composite moral judgment ratings and explicitly classifies it as a 'Successful Replication' that 'is consistent with the results of the original study', confirming shipped and blind 'successful'.
